unlockLines: Timeshares unlocked. Sell them paradise in instalments. You cannot even book the break room, but think tropical, beta.
Palm trees! Ocean views! A contract longer than their holiday! That is hospitality with the soul of a fucking printer jam.
Welcome to luxury travel. You have not left this chair since lunch, but please describe the sunset with authority.
Sell a slice of paradise. Mine includes a private pool. Yours includes a shared kettle and a management-approved daydream.
Make the resort sound irresistible. If you mention our office toilet as a spa facility again, I will end your travel career.
